This application coming on for admission this day, the c  following:
 ORDER

This first application under Section 439 of the Code of Criminal Procedure has been filed on behalf of the applicant for grant of bail relating to FIR No.33/2022 dated (n o t mentioned) registered at Police Station Barela, District Jabalpur for the offence under Sections 363, 376, 376(2)(n), 506 and 34 of the Indian Penal Code, Sections 3, 4, 5 and 6 of the Protection of Children from Sexual Offencs Act and Sections 3(1)(w-ii) and 3(2)(v) of the Scheduled Castes and Scheduled Tribes (Prevention of Rajesh Kumar Barmen vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 21 July, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/94993770/
1 Atrocities) Act.

sentences.text: The applicant is in jail since 20.05.2023.

2. Learned counsel for the applicant submits that at the time of incident, the prosecutrix was minor but later on she became major and the present applicant and the prosecutrix both entered into the marriage as they were in affair.
She submits that the complainant made a complaint after some delay and the applicant, therefore, got arrested.
Under such circumstances, the applicant is entitled to be released on bail.

3. Considering the aforesaid, since both the parties have stated before the Court and even the prosecutrix who is also before the Court has apprised that she already entered into marriage with the applicant and at the time of arrest she was residing with him and still she submits that the present applicant is her husband, though the bail application has been opposed by the counsel for State, but I am inclined to consider and allow this application.
Accordingly, without commenting anything on the merits of the case, this application is allowed.

4. It is directed that the applicant be released on bail upon his furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand) with one solvent surety of the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court concerned for his appearance on the dates given by it.
5 . It is further directed that the applicant shall abide by the conditions enumerated in Section 437(3) of the Code of Criminal Procedure.

6. However, the Superintendent of Police, Jabalpur and Collector Jabalpur are directed that the compensation, if any, is paid to the prosecutrix under any of the schemes sponsored by the Central Government or the State Government, treating her to be a victim of rape, the same shall be recovered from her.

The trial Court is also directed to ensure the recovery of amount, if any, is paid towards compensation to the prosecutrix treating her to be a victim of rape.
7. Let a copy of this order be forwarded to the Superintendent of Police, Jabalpur and Collector Jabalpur for information and necessary compliance.

(SANJAY DWIVEDI) JUDGE ac/-
